---
name: galaxy-tool-submission
description: Use for Galaxy submissions with nested, repeated, conditional, paired, collection, or reference-selector inputs, when raw API payload binding is uncertain, or when staging a large public or reference artifact into a Galaxy history. Skip simple submissions handled by a validating client.
---

# Galaxy Tool Submission

Use this skill after the scientific tool and parameters have been selected. Build
complex inputs from the selected wrapper's live schema and verify the created job
resolved the intended objects.

## Dataset Inputs

- Wait for uploaded data to reach `ok` with the expected datatype before using
  the final history dataset ID.
- Verify paired mates use distinct dataset IDs and preserve forward/reverse
  order.
- For reference-source conditionals, confirm the job resolved the intended
  history reference or built-in genome rather than a default branch.

## Large Public Or Reference Objects

- Stage an authoritative public or refere

Change log.

August 3rd 2022.
The phased chrX VCF and its index were updated as described below.

ChrX files that were withdrawn:
1kGP_high_coverage_Illumina.chrX.filtered.SNV_INDEL_SV_phased_panel.vcf.gz (MD5 hash 1c5609cad368da922c7ecd958bf988c1)
1kGP_high_coverage_Illumina.chrX.filtered.SNV_INDEL_SV_phased_panel.vcf.gz.tbi (MD5 hash e2340118457d938de64c0d264f1de8a1)

New version of the chrX VCF and index:
1kGP_high_coverage_Illumina.chrX.filtered.SNV_INDEL_SV_phased_panel.v2.vcf.gz (MD5 hash d2c80aa7b3bcb8f895f98fd5779fb448)
1kGP_high_coverage_Illumina.chrX.filtered.SNV_INDEL_SV_phased_panel.v2.vcf.gz (MD5 hash 6d4abec5fd7119e6f3152a640d758b13)

Description of changes:
SHAPEIT4 produced diploid output across the entire chromosome X in all samples. To ensure proper ploidy of male samples in the phased panel, we converted “0|1”, “1|0”, and “1|1” GTs into a haploid representation (i.e. “1”) in nonPAR regions of chrX in males in the new (v2) version of the chrX VCF.
